= Overview =
The Community Mod Menu (CMM) is part of the [[Community Mod Framework]] and allows multiple mods to hook into a single shared in-game settings menu through a registration API. For full documentation, see the [https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki GitHub wiki].

[[File:CMM_Example_Mod.png|thumb|600px|The CMM Example Mod.]]

= CMM Visual Editor =
CMM provides a [https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/CMM-Visual-Editor visual editor tool] that generates all required files from a browser-based interface, with no manual coding required.

Run in a terminal to launch:
<syntaxhighlight lang="powershell">
curl.exe -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/main/tools/cmm-visual-editor.bat -o "$env:TEMP\cmm-visual-editor.bat"; & "$env:TEMP\cmm-visual-editor.bat"
</syntaxhighlight>

= Basic Setup =
Register your mod by creating a registration effect and hooking it into CMM's <code>on_action</code>:

<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
# in_game/common/scripted_effects/your_effects.txt
your_mod_register = {
	# Register settings here
}

# in_game/common/on_action/your_on_action.txt
cmm_on_mod_registration = {
	on_actions = {
		your_mod_on_register
	}
}

your_mod_on_register = {
	effect = {
		your_mod_register = yes
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>

Then create a Scripted GUI file and a localization file for your settings.

= Settings =
Each setting type has its own registration effect and parameters. All settings require a Scripted GUI callback named <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_on_changed</code> (except text, which uses a scripted effect callback).

All types except text and settings list have global variants (<code>cmm_register_global_*</code>) that store values in <code>global_var:</code> instead of <code>var:</code> and are host-editable in multiplayer.

== Toggle ==
[[File:CMM_Toggle.png|thumb|right|A CMM toggle.]]
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_register_bool_setting = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_toggle
	tab_id = general
	group_id = general_toggles
	default_value = 0           # 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
}
</syntaxhighlight>
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
your_mod__your_toggle_on_changed = {
	scope = country
	effect = {
		cmm_toggle_bool_setting = {
			setting = your_mod__your_toggle
		}
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>
Value: <code>var:your_mod__your_toggle</code> — <code>0</code> (disabled) or <code>1</code> (enabled).

== Dropdown ==
[[File:CMM_Dropdown.png|thumb|right|A CMM dropdown.]]
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_register_dropdown_setting = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_dropdown
	tab_id = general
	group_id = general_values
	default_index = 1  # Default selected option (starting from 1)
	option_count = 3   # Total number of options
}
</syntaxhighlight>
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
your_mod__your_dropdown_on_changed = {
	scope = country
	effect = {
		cmm_apply_dropdown_change = {
			setting = your_mod__your_dropdown
		}
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>
Value: <code>var:your_mod__your_dropdown</code> — selected option ordinal (starting from 1).

== Button ==
[[File:CMM_Button.png|thumb|right|A CMM button.]]
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_register_button_setting = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_button
	tab_id = general
	group_id = general_toggles
}
</syntaxhighlight>
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
your_mod__your_button_on_changed = {
	scope = country
	effect = {
		# Your custom effect here
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>
No stored value — the callback fires once when clicked.

== Numeric ==
[[File:CMM_Numeric.png|thumb|right|A CMM numeric stepper.]]
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_register_numeric_setting = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_numeric
	tab_id = general
	group_id = general_values
	default_value = 5
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 10
	step_value = 1    # Ctrl+click = 5x step, Shift+click = jump to min/max
}
</syntaxhighlight>
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
your_mod__your_numeric_on_changed = {
	scope = country
	effect = {
		cmm_apply_numeric_change = {
			setting = your_mod__your_numeric
		}
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>
Value: <code>var:your_mod__your_numeric</code> — current numeric value.

== Slider ==
[[File:CMM_Slider.png|thumb|right|A CMM slider.]]
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_register_slider_setting = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_slider
	tab_id = general
	group_id = general_values
	default_value = 50
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 100
	step_value = 1
}
</syntaxhighlight>
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
your_mod__your_slider_on_changed = {
	scope = country
	effect = {
		cmm_apply_slider_change = {
			setting = your_mod__your_slider
		}
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>
Value: <code>var:your_mod__your_slider</code> — current slider value. Players can click to jump, double click to drag, or use the <code>-</code>/<code>+</code> buttons.

== Text ==
[[File:CMM_Text.png|thumb|right|A CMM text input.]]
{{box|Text settings are '''singleplayer only'''.}}
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_register_text_setting = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_text
	tab_id = general
	group_id = general_values
	character_limit = 42  # Minimum 1
	quote_text = 1        # 1 = wrap in double quotes, 0 = no wrap
}
</syntaxhighlight>
Text settings use a '''scripted effect''' callback (not a Scripted GUI):
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
your_mod__your_text_on_changed = {
	# $text$ contains the submitted text
	change_country_name = $text$
}
</syntaxhighlight>

== Settings List ==
[[File:CMM_Ordered_Settings_List.png|thumb|right|An ordered list setting in CMM.]]
A table of items where each row has one or more field columns (toggles, dropdowns, or numeric steppers). Lists can optionally be ordered.

=== Registering a List ===
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_register_settings_list = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_list
	tab_id = general
	item_count = 5    # Number of rows (1-20)
	is_ordered = 1    # 1 = players can reorder, 0 = fixed order
}
</syntaxhighlight>

=== Registering Fields ===
Register fields after the list. Each field becomes a column:
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_register_list_bool_field = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_list
	field_id = enabled
	default_value = 1
}

cmm_register_list_dropdown_field = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_list
	field_id = mode
	default_index = 1
	option_count = 3
}

cmm_register_list_numeric_field = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_list
	field_id = weight
	default_value = 5
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 10
	step_value = 1
}
</syntaxhighlight>

=== List Callback ===
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
your_mod__your_list_on_changed = {
	scope = country
	effect = {
		cmm_apply_list_change = {
			setting = your_mod__your_list
		}
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>

=== Reading List Values ===
Field values are stored as: <code>var:[mod_id]__[setting_id]_item_[N]_field_[slot]</code>
* <code>[N]</code> = item number (1 through <code>item_count</code>)
* <code>[slot]</code> = field registration order (1 through 5)

=== Iterating List Items ===
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_for_each_list_item = {
	setting = your_mod__your_list
	effect = your_mod__your_list_each_item
}

your_mod__your_list_each_item = {
	# $i$ = resolved item number, respects player reordering
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:your_mod__your_list_item_$i$_field_1 = 1
		}
		# Item $i$ has field 1 (enabled) set to true
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>

=== Attaching Values ===
Attach game object scopes to list items for use during iteration:
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_set_list_item_value = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_list
	item = 1
	value = building_type:fine_cloth_guild
}
</syntaxhighlight>
Access during iteration as <code>scope:cmm_list_current_item_value</code>.

=== Dynamic Lists ===
Build lists dynamically instead of specifying a fixed <code>item_count</code>:
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_begin_settings_list = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_list
	tab_id = general
	is_ordered = 0
}

cmm_add_settings_list_item = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_list
	value = building_type:fine_cloth_guild
	name = fine_cloth_guild              # Localization key for row label
}

cmm_finish_settings_list = { mod_id = your_mod setting_id = your_list }
# Register fields after this
</syntaxhighlight>

Or build from an existing country variable list:
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
cmm_register_settings_list_from_list = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_list
	tab_id = general
	is_ordered = 0
	list = my_variable_list  # Country variable list of scopes (max 20)
}
# Register fields after this
</syntaxhighlight>

= Conditional Visibility =
Any Scripted GUI callback can include <code>is_shown</code> to conditionally hide a setting. Works for all types except text.

<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
your_mod__your_toggle_on_changed = {
	scope = country

	is_shown = {
		var:your_mod__some_other_setting = 1
	}

	effect = {
		cmm_toggle_bool_setting = {
			setting = your_mod__your_toggle
		}
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>

= Localization =

{| class="wikitable"
! Key Pattern !! Description
|-
| <code>[mod_id]_name</code> / <code>_desc</code> || Mod name / description
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[tab_id]_name</code> / <code>_desc</code> || Tab name / description
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[group_id]_name</code> / <code>_desc</code> || Group name / description
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_name</code> / <code>_desc</code> || Setting name / description
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_option_[N]_name</code> || Dropdown option label
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_text</code> || Button text
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_item_column_name</code> || List item column header
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_item_[N]_name</code> || List row label
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]__[field_id]_name</code> || List field column label
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]__[field_id]_option_[N]_name</code> || List dropdown field option
|}
